subtext.hi: Board exam level mixed problems solve karo.

text.hi: Ye lesson poore chapter ka mixed practice hai — 1-mark se 3-mark tak ke real board-pattern questions.
text.en: This lesson is mixed practice from the whole chapter — real board-pattern questions from 1-mark to 3-mark.

content.hi: Quick recap: P(E)=n(E)/n(S). Sure Event P=1, Impossible Event P=0. P(E)+P(not E)=1.
content.en: Quick recap: P(E)=n(E)/n(S). Sure Event P=1, Impossible Event P=0. P(E)+P(not E)=1.

content.hi: Coin: n(S)=2, Two coins: n(S)=4. Die: n(S)=6, Two dice: n(S)=36. Cards: n(S)=52.
content.en: Coin: n(S)=2, Two coins: n(S)=4. Die: n(S)=6, Two dice: n(S)=36. Cards: n(S)=52.

problem.hi: 90 discs (1-90 numbered) wale box se ek disc nikala jaata hai. (i) 2-digit number, (ii) perfect square, (iii) 5 se divisible number aane ki probability?
problem.en: A box contains 90 discs numbered 1-90. One disc is drawn at random. Find the probability that it bears: (i) a two-digit number, (ii) a perfect square, (iii) a number divisible by 5.

problem.hi: Ek bag mein 5 red balls hain aur kuch blue balls. Blue ball nikalne ki probability red se double hai. Blue balls ki sankhya nikaalo.
problem.en: A bag contains 5 red balls and some blue balls. If the probability of drawing a blue ball is double that of a red ball, find the number of blue balls.

question.hi: Die throw karne pe perfect square number aane ki probability?
question.en: A die is thrown once. Find the probability of getting a perfect square number.

question.hi: 12 balls wale box mein x black hain. P(black)=x/12. 6 aur black balls add karne pe probability double ho jaati hai. x nikaalo.
question.en: A box has 12 balls, x of which are black. P(black)=x/12. Adding 6 more black balls doubles the probability. Find x.

question.hi: Event ko uski probability se match karo
question.en: Match the event to its probability

notes.hi: 'Double probability' word problems mein equation banao aur solve karo
notes.en: In 'double probability' word problems, form an equation and solve

summary.hi: Probability chapter complete! Ab tum coin, dice, cards, aur word problems — sab confidently solve kar sakte ho.
summary.en: Probability chapter complete! You can now confidently solve coin, dice, cards, and word problems.
